nodes.description: Mapping address => uint storing token balances; mutated in _transferStandard and _takeTeam.
Nested mapping of owner => spender => allowance; written in _approve and read/decremented in transferFrom.
Mapping of addresses exempt from transfer fees; consulted in _transfer.
Mapping address => User struct tracking last buy timestamp used for cooldown/snipe protection.
Mapping of blocked/bot addresses; set by Multicall/delBots and checked at the start of _transfer.
Constant total supply of 1e12 * 10**9 tokens minted to the contract at construction.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps, liquidity and path WETH lookups.
Payable fee recipient wallet one, also used as privileged caller for manual/swap/set functions.
Payable fee recipient wallet two, receives half of the collected ETH.
Address of the created Uniswap pair, used to distinguish buys and sells.
Buy fee percentage, default 6, mutable by setFees.
Sell fee percentage, default 6, mutable by setFees.
Impact fee rate percentage used to cap the swapped contract token balance.
Maximum buy amount allowed during the launch window; set in openTrading.
Maximum tokens a wallet may hold during the launch window; set in openTrading.
Timestamp when trading was opened; drives snipe/cooldown and sell-fee windows.
Flag gating all buy/sell fee logic and transfers into the pair.
Reentrancy lock set by the lockTheSwap modifier around swapTokensForEth.
Flag controlling whether the impact fee cap is applied before swapping.
Contract owner address set in the Ownable constructor and checked by onlyOwner.
ERC20 transfer entrypoint; forwards _msgSender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom; enforces tx.origin anti-bot check on pair buys and decrements allowance.
Core transfer logic containing buy/sell fee branching, cooldown checks, timestamp gating and ETH/swap calls.
Swaps accumulated contract tokens for ETH via the Uniswap router under lockTheSwap.
Distributes contract ETH balance equally to the two fee addresses via low-level transfer.
Computes the fee through _getFee and performs the standard balance movement.
Returns the applicable buy/sell fee, adding a 5% penalty within 15 minutes of launch.
Applies _getValues and mutates _owned balances of sender and recipient.
Pure helper computing team fee and net transfer amount from amount and fee.
Credits the collected team fee to the contract balance in _owned.
Owner-only setup creating the pair and adding initial ETH/token liquidity to Uniswap.
Owner-only switch enabling trading and initialising launch timestamps and caps.
Fee-address-only manual trigger to swap the full contract token balance for ETH.
Fee-address-only manual trigger to send the whole contract ETH balance to the fee wallets.
Updates _feeRate; protected by onlyOwner and an explicit _FeeAddress1 caller check.
Updates buy/sell fees with caller restricted to _FeeAddress1 and a 10% ceiling.
Fee-address-only batch flagging of addresses as bots in _isBot.
Fee-address-only batch clearing of bot flags in _isBot.
Replaces _FeeAddress1; caller must be the current _FeeAddress1.
Replaces _FeeAddress2; caller must be the current _FeeAddress2.
Owner-only toggle of the _useImpactFeeSetter flag.
Read-only getter returning the _owned balance of an account.
ERC20 approve entrypoint forwarding to the internal _approve.
Internal allowance setter validating non-zero owner and spender.
Caller-supplied sender used for ownership, fee-address and allowance checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for launch windows, cooldowns, deadline and sell fee penalty.
Origin address used in transferFrom to block bot contracts during pair buys.
External call into the Uniswap router swapping tokens for ETH; executes before state finalisation and can call back.
Native ETH transfer to _FeeAddress1/_FeeAddress2, a state-changing external call with unbounded gas.
Unchecked arithmetic subtraction of amount from the stored allowance in transferFrom.
External payable call to the router providing the entire contract ETH balance as liquidity.
External call approving the router for the maximum uint amount on the pair token.
Destination address parameter of transfer.
Token amount parameter of transfer.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Token amount parameter of transferFrom.
Account whose balance is queried in balanceOf.
Source address parameter of the internal _transfer.
Destination address parameter of the internal _transfer.
Token amount parameter of the internal _transfer.
Local flag in _transfer distinguishing buy-side fee treatment.
Local flag in _transfer deciding whether fees apply based on exclusions.
Local holding the contract token balance to be swapped, capped by the impact fee rate.
Local holding the contract ETH balance forwarded to the fee addresses.
Token amount parameter passed to swapTokensForEth.
Swap path array [token, WETH] built inside swapTokensForEth.
ETH amount parameter distributed by sendETHToFee.
Sender address parameter of _tokenTransfer.
Recipient address parameter of _tokenTransfer.
Amount parameter of _tokenTransfer.
Boolean fee flag parameter of _tokenTransfer.
Boolean buy flag parameter of _tokenTransfer.
Boolean fee flag parameter of _getFee.
Boolean buy flag parameter of _getFee.
Local fee value returned by _getFee.
Sender address parameter of _transferStandard.
Recipient address parameter of _transferStandard.
Amount parameter of _transferStandard.
Fee parameter of _transferStandard.
Amount parameter of _getValues.
Team fee percentage parameter of _getValues.
Team fee token amount parameter of _takeTeam.
Array of addresses to flag as bots in Multicall.
Array of addresses to unflag in delBots.
New fee wallet parameter of updateFeeAddress1.
New fee wallet parameter of updateFeeAddress2.
New impact fee rate parameter of setFeeRate.
New buy fee parameter of setFees.
New sell fee parameter of setFees.
Boolean flag parameter of toggleImpactFee.

edges.reason: transfer forwards _msgSender() as the sender of the token movement.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() when decrementing and re-approving the allowance.
tx.origin is compared with the recipient to enforce an origin-based anti-bot restriction.
_transfer receives the caller-derived from address and compares it against owner().
Launch window, cooldown and snipe checks in _transfer depend on block.timestamp.
_getFee adds a penalty based on block.timestamp relative to _launchedAt.
openTrading records block.timestamp into _launchedAt.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
swapTokensForEth uses block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
manualswap requires _msgSender() to equal _FeeAddress1.
manualsend requires _msgSender() to equal _FeeAddress1.
setFeeRate requires _msgSender() to equal _FeeAddress1.
setFees requires _msgSender() to equal _FeeAddress1.
Multicall requires _msgSender() to equal _FeeAddress1 before flagging bots.
delBots requires _msgSender() to equal _FeeAddress1 before clearing bot flags.
updateFeeAddress1 requires _msgSender() to equal the current _FeeAddress1.
updateFeeAddress2 requires _msgSender() to equal the current _FeeAddress2.
approve forwards _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
_approve receives the caller-derived owner when writing the allowance.
The onlyOwner modifier on addLiquidity checks _owner against _msgSender().
The onlyOwner modifier on openTrading checks _owner against _msgSender().
setFeeRate is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
toggleImpactFee is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
_transfer calls owner() to decide whether the buy/sell branches apply.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer after the origin check.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer with the resolved fee decision.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth on the sell path before completing balance accounting.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee to push ETH out during the sell path.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth, performing an external swap.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee, performing native ETH transfers.
_tokenTransfer calls _getFee to compute the applicable fee.
_tokenTransfer delegates balance mutation to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to split amount and fee.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to credit the collected fee.
approve delegates to the internal _approve.
balanceOf reads the _owned mapping.
_transfer gates buy/sell logic behind the _tradingOpen flag.
_transfer reverts when _isBot[from] is set.
_transfer reads and writes cooldown records for buy/sell throttling.
_transfer enforces _maxBuyAmount during the launch window.
_transfer enforces _maxHeldTokens during the first hour.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against _launchedAt for gating.
_transfer uses uniswapV2Pair to identify buys and sells.
_transfer checks _inSwap before performing the sell-side swap.
_transfer conditionally applies the impact fee based on _useImpactFeeSetter.
_transfer uses _feeRate to cap the swapped token balance.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to decide takeFee.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router to build the path and swap.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _FeeAddress1 with an unguarded native transfer.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _FeeAddress2 with an unguarded native transfer.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap that can reenter the contract.
Native ETH transfer to the fee wallets executes before _inSwap is cleared in the sell path.
addLiquidityETH is an external payable router call forwarding the whole contract balance.
addLiquidity approves the router on the pair token via an external call.
transferFrom subtracts amount from the stored allowance without a checked bound.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads _allowances to derive the remaining allowance.
_getFee reads _buyFee for buy transactions.
_getFee reads _sellFee for sell transactions.
_getFee compares block.timestamp to _launchedAt plus 15 minutes.
openTrading sets _tradingOpen to true.
openTrading writes _launchedAt.
openTrading initialises _maxBuyAmount.
openTrading initialises _maxHeldTokens.
setFeeRate writes _feeRate after the caller checks.
setFees writes _buyFee after the caller check and bound.
setFees writes _sellFee after the caller check and bound.
Multicall writes _isBot flags in a loop.
delBots clears _isBot flags in a loop.
updateFeeAddress1 rewrites _FeeAddress1.
updateFeeAddress2 rewrites _FeeAddress2.
toggleImpactFee writes _useImpactFeeSetter.
addLiquidity sets uniswapV2Router to the hard-coded mainnet router.
addLiquidity creates and stores the Uniswap pair in uniswapV2Pair.
addLiquidity approves the router for the full total supply.
_transferStandard debits the sender and credits the recipient in _owned.
_takeTeam credits the contract balance in _owned.
The constructor seeds _owned[address(this)] with _totalSupply.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only routes the destination address into the transfer function.
The amount parameter only carries the token quantity through the transfer function.
The spender parameter is only used to build the approve allowance entry.
The amount parameter is only used to set the approve allowance value.
The sender parameter is consumed by the transferFrom allowance and transfer logic.
The recipient parameter is only relevant to the transferFrom origin check and transfer call.
The amount parameter is the value moved and subtracted inside transferFrom.
The account parameter is only the lookup key of the balanceOf getter.
The from parameter drives all buy/sell branching inside the internal _transfer.
The to parameter drives all buy/sell branching inside the internal _transfer.
The amount parameter is the value moved inside the internal _transfer.
isBuy is a helper local deciding the fee branch of the internal _transfer.
takeFee is a helper local deciding whether fees are applied in the internal _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is the value ultimately passed from _transfer into swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is the value ultimately passed from _transfer into sendETHToFee.
The tokenAmount parameter is the sole input of swapTokensForEth.
The path array is a transient swap routing local of swapTokensForEth.
The amount parameter is the sole input of sendETHToFee.
The sender parameter is forwarded by _tokenTransfer into _transferStandard.
The recipient parameter is forwarded by _tokenTransfer into _transferStandard.
The amount parameter is forwarded by _tokenTransfer into _transferStandard.
The takefee parameter is forwarded from _tokenTransfer into _getFee.
The buy parameter is forwarded from _tokenTransfer into _getFee.
The takefee parameter controls whether _getFee returns a fee at all.
The buy parameter selects between buy and sell fee logic in _getFee.
The fee local is the computed return value of _getFee.
The sender parameter selects the balance debited in _transferStandard.
The recipient parameter selects the balance credited in _transferStandard.
The amount parameter is the pre-fee value debited in _transferStandard.
The fee parameter is passed into _getValues for the split in _transferStandard.
The amount parameter is the base value split by _getValues.
The teamFee parameter is the percentage applied by _getValues.
The team parameter is the only input credited by _takeTeam.
The bots_ array is the only input iterated by Multicall.
The bots_ array is the only input iterated by delBots.
The newAddress parameter is only assigned to _FeeAddress1 in updateFeeAddress1.
The newAddress parameter is only assigned to _FeeAddress2 in updateFeeAddress2.
The rate parameter is only assigned to _feeRate in setFeeRate.
The buy parameter is only assigned to _buyFee in setFees.
The sell parameter is only assigned to _sellFee in setFees.
The onoff parameter is only assigned to _useImpactFeeSetter in toggleImpactFee.
